verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a SaaS email product, so webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The MCP server lets AI assistants drive the inbox, and agents can 'run proactively based on triggers', but neither is event subscription via webhooks. No OpenAPI spec was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
